summary: Embeds another operator's viewer inside a Panel COMP with optional interactivity, panning, scaling, direct TOP drawing, and normal panel layout/look/drag-drop behavior.

key_params.name: opviewer
key_params.note: Target operator whose node viewer is displayed

key_params.name: interactive
key_params.note: Allows mouse or touch interaction with the target viewer

key_params.name: opcenter
key_params.note: Pan center for the displayed viewer when scaled

key_params.name: opcenterunit
key_params.note: Panel units, fraction, relative fraction, or display points for Center

key_params.name: opscale
key_params.note: Zoom factor for the embedded viewer

key_params.name: topdirect
key_params.note: For TOPs, draw the RGBA image directly instead of viewer overlays

key_params.name: contentsize
key_params.note: Use TOP texture size rather than panel size when calculating center

key_concepts: OP Viewer COMP embeds any target operator viewer inside a Panel COMP.
Interactive mode optionally forwards mouse or touch interaction to the embedded operator viewer.
Center, center unit, scale, and content-size controls pan and zoom the displayed viewer region.
Draw TOP Directly displays a TOP's raw RGBA image instead of the normal viewer overlays.
Because it is a panel, layout size, enable, display, and panel interaction settings still control whether users can see or use it.
common_gotchas: OP Viewer COMP embeds the target operator's viewer, not necessarily the target operator's raw output data.
For TOP inspection, Draw TOP Directly avoids viewer overlays and shows the RGBA image like a Select TOP would.
Interactive mode can pass mouse or touch behavior into the target viewer, which may be undesirable in dashboard-style panels.
Center and Content Size behave differently for TOPs because panel units may map to texture pixels.
Scaling magnifies the viewer; use Center parameters to keep the intended region visible.
Panel enable/display state can prevent expected interaction even when the OP Viewer parameter setup is correct.
